scope: All 735 canonical workbook teams, with separate Home and Away slots. Preserve workbook associations, reserve identities, seasons and IDs.
selection: Use the candidate season only after it matches the source page. Never substitute Third, GK, Training, Women's, youth or a first team for a reserve slot. Previous-season kits require explicit research review rather than silent substitution.
colors: Save the archive's color names verbatim. HEX values are estimates from visually reviewed reference images unless the source explicitly publishes values.
artwork: Recreate observed graphics as validated paint on the original PNG. Remove sponsors, emblems and lettering. Recolor only the existing round collar. A scraped record is not a ready kit.
access: Use public pages and public front images. Normal browser verification may complete on its own. Direct HTTP challenge or rate-limit responses stop the HTTP transport. No bypass, hidden APIs or Plus-only imagery.
history: Preserve existing approved kit/layout revisions and earlier official-source evidence. New or changed designs use new revisions. Archive reconciliation is separate from historical readiness.

tier1_season_policy.instruction: Prefer 2026/27; user permits independently evidenced 2026 fallbacks to finish Tier 1. Keep the literal source season and disclose any previous-season fallback.

tier2_continuation.instruction: Continue the same independent Home/Away research and artwork workflow for the 150 preserved Domestic tier-2 teams. Prefer verified 2026/27, using independently evidenced 2026 when unconfirmed. Preserve literal labels and record any fallback per slot; no automatic older-season substitution. A saved source or draft is not a ready kit.

latest_available_equipment.instruction: When no independently evidenced 2025, 2026 or 2027 shirt is available, use the latest older equipment for that canonical Home/Away slot. Preserve its actual season and independent identity. This supersedes earlier age restrictions; Third/GK, first-team-for-reserve and namesake substitutions remain excluded.
